content_blocks.title: Project Summary – Overview
content_blocks.content: PeptAI is described as an autonomous AI agent that discovers peptide drug candidates through an 8-gate validation pipeline plus a wet-lab gate. The pipeline chains structure prediction, molecular dynamics, and safety scoring into one agent-driven workflow. The claimed benefit is compression of computational discovery from months to hours. Results are published on-chain and the platform is community-governed. No experimental data, quantitative results, or validated candidates are presented.

content_blocks.title: Problem Statement
content_blocks.content: Conventional peptide drug discovery workflows take 2–5 years and millions of dollars from target to validated candidate. Existing tools are siloed, requiring researchers to integrate 12+ specialized software packages with no unified validation framework or reproducibility guarantees. This is a qualitative framing of the market problem; no primary data or citations are provided.

content_blocks.title: Impact / Value Proposition
content_blocks.content: PeptAI claims to democratize peptide drug discovery by running validation as a public, auditable process. The 8-gate pipeline is stated to take candidates from structure through safety in hours rather than months, with all results published on-chain for verification and reproducibility. The platform aims to reduce cost and broaden access beyond well-funded labs. These are aspirational claims with no supporting experimental evidence presented in this document.
